method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a convex pentagon with side order around the boundary A-B-C-D-E-A, initially resting on side AB on the x-axis with A at 0 and B to the right, and rolling clockwise. From the text, use the side lengths AB=3, BC=4, CD=6, DE=3, EA=7 and the target position x=2009. Because a convex polygon rolling without slipping places its sides on the ground in cyclic order, the x-axis is partitioned into repeating intervals of lengths 3,4,6,3,7 labeled AB, BC, CD, DE, EA. The perimeter is 23, so reduce 2009 modulo 23: 2009=87*23+8. In one period, the intervals are AB: 0 to 3, BC: 3 to 7, CD: 7 to 13, DE: 13 to 16, EA: 16 to 23. Since remainder 8 lies between 7 and 13, the side touching x=2009 is CD.
